newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's FNB signs 1.5 bln rand outsourcing deal.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's FNB signs 1.5 bln rand outsourcing deal.

text.p: First National Bank of Southern Africa said on Sunday it had signed the largest outsourcing contract yet in South Africa with EDS over 10 years, worth an estimated 1.5 billion rand.

EDS, a U.S.-based information technology services group, would manage and operate FNB's cheque processing and centralised back-office ledger functions, the South African banking group said in a statement. The deal is effective from July 1 and involves a move of about FNB employees across to EDS.
FNB currently processes about 20 million cheques, statements and vouchers a month. EDS will be paid on the basis of volumes handled and performance levels achieved.
The deal outstrips the one billion rand credit card processing outsourcing deal EDS signed with Standard Bank last year which at the time was the largest of its kind in South Africa.
